releaseNotes: Expands the offline biblical dictionary from 100 to 110 contextual entries, adding Incarnation, Hypostatic Union, Theosis, Kenosis, Septuagint, Biblical Typology, Apocalyptic Literature, Day of the Lord, Kinsman-Redeemer and Expiation. Each entry includes a concise definition, KJV references and an editorial caution to distinguish biblical text, historical context and later theological terminology.
